targetType.description: Whether to target Storybook stories or real-FE routes. Defaults to storybook.

targets.description: List of story paths or route URLs to capture.

id.description: Stable identifier used to match screenshots to baselines.

url.description: URL or Storybook story path to capture.

diffThresholdPercent.description: Per-target override for the pixel diff threshold. Defaults to 0.1.

snapshotDir.description: Path to directory where baseline screenshots are stored. Agent reads baselines from here and optionally writes new ones.

diffThresholdPercent.description: Global pixel diff threshold percentage below which a comparison is considered passing. Default: 0.1.

updateBaseline.description: When true and the run has no critical or high findings, overwrite existing baselines with current screenshots.
